title: chore: add Exa MCP secret
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds the SOPS-encrypted `EXA_API_KEY` used by the Exa MCP Worker.
- Uses one shared credential for staging and production.
- Contains no runtime or deployment changes.

Stacked on #14013.

gist.headline: A key for the search garden
gist.blurb: The Exa MCP Worker now has its encrypted key tucked safely into the tool shed. Staging and production share one carefully guarded spare.
gist.summary: Added a SOPS-encrypted EXA_API_KEY secret for the Exa MCP Worker, shared by staging and production, with no runtime or deployment behavior changes.
gist.impact: This prepares the Exa MCP Worker to access its Exa credential consistently across staging and production without changing the live service yet.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a careful gardener placing a glowing key into a small locked seed box beside a cozy Exa search terminal. A tiny code-plant and shared path between two garden signs, “staging” and “production,” represent the single encrypted credential; this is internal setup rather than a visible product change.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny gardener's key ring, carefully placing a glowing encrypted key into a locked seed box beside a retro search terminal; two little garden paths labeled “STAGING” and “PRODUCTION” meet at the same box, with code-plants and flowers growing nearby. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, dark purple (#110518) outlines, emotionally warm and gently technical.
